# ghost/wikipedia

Wikipedia: search articles, read an article's title, description and lead, get today's featured article, save an article offline. No account.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/wikipedia
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/wikipedia search_articles --device <serial> --param query=<query>
ghost skill run ghost/wikipedia open_article --device <serial> --param title=<title>
ghost skill run ghost/wikipedia get_featured_article --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/wikipedia save_article --device <serial> --param title=<title>
```

## Actions

- `search_articles`: Search Wikipedia for Alan Turing
- `open_article`: What does Wikipedia say about Ada Lovelace?
- `get_featured_article`: What's today's featured article on Wikipedia?
- `save_article`: Save the Wikipedia article on Alan Turing for offline reading
